title: Warnings of Scripture
definition: The Warnings of Scripture are God’s truthful calls to turn from sin, deception, unbelief, and danger before destruction comes.
summary: The Warnings of Scripture are God’s truthful calls to turn from sin, deception, unbelief, and danger before destruction comes.
christFocus: Jesus warned with love and authority, calling people to repentance, watchfulness, and true faith in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture’s warnings are not cruel. They are expressions of God’s truth and mercy. A warning tells the truth about danger so people may turn, flee, repent, endure, and live.

The Bible warns against unbelief, hypocrisy, false teaching, hardened hearts, sexual sin, greed, pride, idolatry, spiritual laziness, and many other dangers. These warnings are given because sin deceives and consequences are real.

Jesus Himself warned people. His warnings were never empty fear tactics; they were holy truth from the Savior who came to seek and save the lost. Scripture’s warnings point us back to Christ as the only safe refuge.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people avoid warnings because they have experienced fear-based religion. Others ignore warnings because they want comfort without correction. Scripture gives a better way: warnings rooted in truth, mercy, and the call to return to God.

This doctrine is vital in recovery and discipleship because danger must be named honestly. Grace does not pretend sin is harmless; grace calls sinners home.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not harden your heart when Scripture warns you. Receive God’s warning as mercy, turn from sin quickly, seek help where needed, and run to Christ who receives repentant sinners and gives power to walk in newness of life.
